clusterSharedFolder.description:
The local file system mount point for the shared file system accessible across the entire C3 cluster *AND*
auxiliary dependency runtimes, such as Selenium. A file placed in this folder is guaranteed to be accessible from
all nodes in the cluster as well as from auxiliary dependency runtimes appropriately configured.

title:
Temporary strongly typed access for test file system-related environmental configuration elements. It was introduced
to expose the location of the shared file system that can be used by tests to share files between C3 nodes and the
Selenium pod, in a multi-node cluster topology.
name: TestFileSystemConfig
